content.text:
===== CONTAINERS =====
startuphafen-devcontainer	Up 5 minutes
startuphafen-devcontainer-caddy-1	Up 33 seconds
startuphafen-devcontainer-database-1	Up 12 minutes (healthy)
startuphafen-devcontainer-keycloak-1	Up 11 minutes (healthy)
startuphafen-devcontainer-keycloak-database-1	Up 11 minutes (healthy)
startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1	Up 12 minutes (unhealthy)
startuphafen-devcontainer-pgadmin-1	Up 12 minutes

===== FRONTEND via caddy:4000 =====
  GET / -> 200
===== KEYCLOUD =====
  28080 direct /realms -> 404
  JWKS certs -> 200
  --- token login as alice (activated user) ---
  alice login -> 200
  --- token login as admin (realm admin) ---
  admin login -> 200
===== BACKEND tRPC (auth-gated, anon role) via caddy:4000 =====
  FeatureFlags.getFeatureFlags -> 200
===== DATABASE =====
ERROR:  relation "sh_feature_flag" does not exist
    14

observation.command:
echo "===== CONTAINERS ====="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}" | sort
echo; echo "===== FRONTEND via caddy:4000 ====="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  GET / -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4000/
echo "===== KEYCLOUD ====="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  28080 direct /realms -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:28080/realms
curl -s http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/certs -o /dev/null -w "  JWKS certs -> %{http_code}\n"
echo "  --- token login as alice (activated user) ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "client_id=startuphafen_app&grant_type=password&username=alice&password=alice" -o /dev/null -w "  alice login -> %{http_code}\n"
echo "  --- token login as admin (realm admin) ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "client_id=admin-cli&grant_type=password&username=admin&password=admin" -o /dev/null -w "  admin login -> %{http_code}\n"
echo "===== BACKEND tRPC (auth-gated, anon role) via caddy:4000 ====="
curl -s "http://localhost:4000/trpc/FeatureFlags.getFeatureFlags" -o /dev/null -w "  FeatureFlags.getFeatureFlags -> %{http_code}\n"
echo "===== DATABASE ====="
docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer-database-1 psql -U app -d app -tc "select count(*) from sh_feature_flag;" 2>&1 | head -1
docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer-database-1 psql -U app -d app -tc "select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public';" 2>&1 | head -1
